meta.source: scripts/build-hyeonchungwon.mjs, at 1/4 on the real place: the cemetery's outline, roads, paths, stairs, burial plots, water, lawns and buildings from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; scripts/data/hyeonchungwon-osm.json); the ground from SRTM (scripts/data/hyeonchungwon-dem.json). Roads are game-size wide (3.2 m), buildings game-size high (OSM has no heights).

approx.what: Hyeonchungmun, the Memorial Tower and the court between them at 50%
approx.why: Yozi 2026-11-24: the whole court at 50% about the gate's middle (at 1/4 the tower is 3 m across). The gate is on its real spot; the tower stands 21.1 m behind its real one, and the court covers 1482 m² (OSM's court at 1/4: 228 m²).

OSM has the court's outline, the gate and the tower only. The paved forecourt in front of the gate, the tower's terrace (1.2 m up), its stairs, the altar and the incense burner are laid out from Yozi's photos.

From Yozi's photos (the gate: blue-green tiled roof on white columns with two low wings; the tower: a tall granite shaft on a stepped base): outlines and heights are approximate (tower 31 m real, 15.5 m here).
OSM has its spot and the round road; the two basins, the jets and the bronze figures with the flag are from Yozi's photos. 6.8 m across (it fills the island inside the round road) and 8.4 m high.

The closed land within 90 m of the hill is drawn as a wooded ridge (SRTM at 1/4, sinking to 0 at its far edge and at the streets). The real ridge is there, but its far slope is homes, not wood; you see it only, nothing stands on it.

approx.what: wood inside the grounds and the trees round the court
approx.why: Every slope that is not a plot, a lawn, a way or a building is drawn as wood (one mesh of treetops; the aerial photo shows wood round the plots, OSM has no outline for it). Two rows of tall trees stand along the court behind the gate, as in the photos; their spots are made up, and no headstones are drawn within 9 m of the court there.
One flag on a 11 m pole beside the forecourt; the real flags stand on the lawn's edge, their exact spots are not in OSM.
Rows of plain white stones on a 2.6 x 2 m grid inside each OSM plot: the real rows and their number are not in OSM. No names, no single graves.

approx.what: lawn in front of the gate (겨레얼마당)
approx.why: The ground between OSM's roads from the fountain to the forecourt (1399 m²), level and open to walk on; OSM has no outline for it.
The ground round the main gate, the visitor office and the fountain is drawn level (the real ground there is within about 1 m).

The hill fades to 0 over 4 m at its foot, but a road keeps its own height: where the ring road runs on the foot (9 places on the Hyeonchung-ro side, where the foot is cut 16 m back from the street) a bank of 0.7 to 3.2 m is left. Kept as an exception (Yozi 2026-11-24): fix later if needed by lowering those stretches.
